method: flatness excess per 2 m elevation band inside each sub-basin's 45 km reach; bench elevation = flattest cell within 1.5 km of the level set

verdict.reading: a shoreline the DEM preserves shows a flatness excess at one stage and a bench residual whose spread is metres, not tens of metres; a residual IQR comparable to the bench search window means no datum was resolved
verdict.confound: every basin's lowest bands carry a large excess because basin floors are flat for reasons that have nothing to do with a shoreline; a stage count that is only large at the floors is not evidence of a datum
